name: Phase_1_Assessment_Brownfields
title: Phase 1 Assessment SARR Brownfields (Public View)
description: This layer provides geographic data on Brownfields sites that are participating in South Carolina’s Brownfields Program. The Program supports the identification, assessment, and remediation of properties where redevelopment or reuse may be complicated by actual or perceived environmental contamination. These properties often include former commercial or industrial facilities that have become underutilized or abandoned. The mapping of these locations helps guide environmental decision-making, redevelopment planning, and community revitalization efforts.
